newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy H1 data in line with 97 deficit goal - Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy H1 data in line with 97 deficit goal - Ciampi.

text.p: First half state account data shows the Italian government is on course to meet its full 1997 deficit target, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said in a statement on Tuesday.
"The first half result is in line with the Maastricht goal of 3.0 percent for the year," Ciampi said.
Earlier the Treasury said Italy's public sector borrowing requirement (PSBR) in the first six months of the year was roughly 25.4 trillion lire against 53.746 trillion in the same period in 1996.

Italy has pledged to cut its deficit in 1997 to three percent of gross domestic product (GDP), as demanded by the Maastricht Treaty for countries wishing to sign up to the single European currency, from 6.7 percent in 1996. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
